_units: cm in the robot base frame: x forward, y left, z up, table = 0. Angles in degrees.

reach._help: Where IK solves AND the shoulder holds a loaded arm. Measure by driving the tip there; do not guess.

input_zone._help: Rectangle where packs arrive. scan() only reports packs inside it.

no_go_zones._help: Rectangles the arm must never enter (camera stand, cables, lamps).
no_go_zones.name: camera stand

cameras._help: Station camera queue ids (GET /api/v1/cameras). They change when a camera is replugged.

calibration._help: Pixel -> table homography from touch points. Fit at box-top height if packs are tall.

bump_markers._help: Fixed markers (e.g. corner crosses). Their pixel positions at calibration time; if one moves more than tolerance_px, every tool stops with 'recalibrate'.

slots_help: Packs lie in fixed slots marked on the sheet; their positions are the taught poses in motion.json.

occupancy._help: A slot counts as filled when the stand camera differs from the empty-table photo around the slot by more than diff_threshold (0-255). agent/teach.py empty takes the photo.

_provisional.note: The paper polygon is a vision mask. The support polygon describes interpolation coverage. Neither establishes reach. Existing reach settings are inherited. Input zone remains unset pending motion verification. This metadata is for review; the current executor does not enforce it.
